children: U.S. hotel REIT's Q3 revenue rose yr/yr and beat analyst expectations
Pro forma RevPAR rose 7.2% yr/yr, driven by demand growth and pricing power
Company raised full-year 2026 guidance after strong Q3 results
Summit Hotel Properties raises 2026 outlook for pro forma RevPAR growth, Adjusted EBITDAre, and AFFO
Company expects 2026 pro forma RevPAR growth of 3.5% to 4.5%
Company forecasts 2026 Adjusted EBITDAre between $181 mln and $186 mln
DEMAND AND PRICING - Co said Q3 RevPAR growth was driven by broad-based demand and pricing power, especially midweek in urban markets
BUSINESS AND GROUP TRAVEL - Co attributed portfolio growth to recovery in business transient travel and ongoing strength in group demand
MARGIN EXPANSION - Co said profitability growth was aided by expanded hotel EBITDA margins
Q3 Net Loss Attributable to Common Stockholders
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialized reits peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Summit Hotel Properties, Inc. is $7.00, about 1.4% below its November 2 closing price of $7.10
